authorization: User explicitly allowed only source-grounded parameter/reference-field bindings. Scoring logic, True/False encoding, obligation predicates and analysis capabilities remain unchanged.
frozen_logical_IR: boolean-obligations-v1; logical answer and entry.answer; native string/None and trusted canonical True/False string; strip/lower and reward>=1

native_binding.candidate: Native function parameter, or one literal-key field in a native parameter mapping
native_binding.reference: Native function parameter containing canonical reference scalar, or one literal-key field in a native parameter mapping
native_binding.source: Exact upstream scoring function AST; never rename source, create wrapper, inline helper, slice batch or convert output encodings.

consumer: Import and hash-check existing v2 checker/IR and underlying old AST theory. Narrow subclass maps only proven source parameter/field reads to existing candidate/reference Terms; separate wrapper preserves existing per-obligation certificates/counterexamples and Unknown policy. No operation or library model additions.
limits: Only direct parameter or one-level literal-key mapping bindings
No list indexing/batch flattening, boxed/XML parser substitution, bool conversion, new helper semantics, result-dict coercion or reward transformation
Same mapping parameter may provide two distinct fields; unrelated fields not modeled
Active obligations copied exactly from LLM; no default completion
evaluation: Fresh actual bare True/False tasks with original independent reward implementations. Reference contracts fixed before model outputs, input probes fixed before detector outcomes. Semgrep remains unfiltered native source-pattern baseline. Pure symbolic control uses same bound source engine with reference obligations, LLM condition differs only in chosen obligations.
